name: video-transcribe
description: Video Transcribe for Claude Code, served from its own repository.

plugins.name: video-transcribe
plugins.description: Turn a video into a timestamped transcript, using its subtitles or local Whisper speech recognition. Transcribing uses no AI tokens, and its accuracy does not depend on the AI model; the agent reads the transcript only when you ask about the video, so the tokens it uses for a transcription do not depend on the video's length.
